start_base_log_reader: create a BaseLogReader with a log directory path and call start to parse the binary logging file
decode_and_handle_hook: decode a hook event by hook_id and dispatch to the appropriate on_* handler method
handle_player_spawned_hook: review the PLAYER_SPAWNED hook decoding that reads entity id, name, position, and look data
handle_player_moving_hook: summarize the PLAYER_MOVING hook that decodes entity id, old position, and new position from the log
handle_block_hooks: review the PLAYER_BROKEN_BLOCK and PLAYER_PLACED_BLOCK hooks that decode block placement and breaking events
